QUOTE: "When `hasSearch` is true, it renders `<NavigationSearch {...searchProps} ref={ref} />` (`index.tsx:128-135`)." and "If `hasSearch` is false, `NavigationSearch` is never rendered, so a ref passed to `NavigationHeader` stays `null`."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the ref is forwarded to NavigationSearch, which renders only when `hasSearch` is true, and that otherwise the ref stays null, attached to nothing.
